correctness.rationale: The generator gives the moment equations in RESULT.md:35–43 without a boundary-flux argument: A=E[XV] has transport source E[V²]=v²P(active), loss λA, and resting-to-moving source α₀ηB/t, while B=E[X²1_rest] has inflow λ(M−B) and outflow 2ηB/3. The active probability is 1−(λ/γ)(1−e^(−γt)), and the positive source and B≥0 give A>0 and M'=2A>0. Transforming the scalar equation after multiplying by t gives RESULT.md:56–64 with the stated signs and normalizations. For I~s^(1+θ), (IF)'~−Cs^(θ−2); below 1 the divergent integral dominates the integration constant, and at 1 it gives C log(1/s)+O(1). The nonnegative, nondecreasing M meets the monotone-density hypothesis of the Laplace Tauberian step (Γ(2)=1). Thus both physical-time limits and amplitudes are correct; the scale λ in the logarithm has no leading effect at fixed rates. The strict condition λ/η<2/3 is exactly the feasibility of θ=1 in the open reinforcement interval; divergence as θ approaches 1 presupposes that approach is available.
